camel_example: aliyun cbn DescribeCens --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key tagtest --PageSize 10 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm3unpnuw0000' --PageNumber 1 --Filter.1.Value.1 'cen-44m0p68spvlrqq0000' --Tag.1.Value tagtest --Filter.1.Key CenId
description_en: Queries information about Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instances under the current Alibaba Cloud account, including the instance status, whether IPv6 is enabled, and the list of bandwidth packages associated with the instances
description_zh: 调用DescribeCens接口查询当前阿里云账号下的云企业网实例的状态、是否已开启IPv6功能、实例绑定的带宽包的列表等信息
kebab_example: aliyun cbn describe-cens --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --resource-group-id rg-acfm3unpnuw0000 --filter '[{"Value":["cen-44m0p68spvlrqq0000"],"Key":"CenId"}]' --tag Value=tagtest Key=tagtest --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCens

parameters.help_en: The page number to query. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页显示的条目数。取值范围：1~50。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the CEN instance belongs
parameters.help_zh: 云企业网实例所属的资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en:
The filter condition. Valid values:

CenId: the CEN instance ID.
Name: the CEN instance name.

The relationship between multiple filter conditions is AND, which means that a record must match all filter conditions to be returned.

You can specify up to 5 filter conditions at a time
fields.help_zh:
过滤条件。取值：

CenId：云企业网实例ID。
Name：云企业网实例名称。

多个过滤条件之间默认是与的关系，即必须符合所有过滤条件，才视为匹配过滤条件。

一次最多支持输入5个过滤条件
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The value of the filter condition.

Specify filter values based on the Key parameter. You can specify multiple filter values for a single Key. The relationship between multiple filter values is OR, which means that a record is returned if it matches any of the filter values.

You can specify up to 5 filter values for each filter condition
fields.help_zh:
过滤条件的值。

根据Key指定过滤值。一个Key支持指定多个过滤值，多个过滤值之间是或的关系，即只要符合其中一个过滤值，则视为匹配该过滤条件。

一个过滤条件最多支持输入5个过滤值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The filter conditions.

You can specify up to 5 filter conditions at a time
parameters.help_zh:
过滤条件的信息。

一次最多支持输入5个过滤条件
parameters.name: filter

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource.

The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

You can specify up to 20 tag keys at a time
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。

一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`或者`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https:// `。

一次最多支持输入20个标签的标签键
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource.

The tag value can be an empty string or up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

Each tag key corresponds to one tag value. You can specify up to 20 tag values at a time
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。

标签值可以为空或输入不超过128个字符的字符串，不能以`aliyun`或者`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https:// `。

每一个标签键对应一个标签值，一次最多支持输入20个标签键对应的标签值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The tag information.

You can specify up to 20 tags at a time
parameters.help_zh:
标签信息。

一次最多支持输入20个标签信息
parameters.name: tag
